The '''Gorach ascension''' was a conflict that, according to legend, occurred thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. During the conflict, the warrior-like [[Gorach]] [[Species/Legends|species]] subjugated dozens of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]], including the planet [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]].
